skycosmetics.name: SkyCosmetics
modmenu.summaryTranslation.skycosmetics: Skins, dyes, names and glint for your SkyBlock items and pets.
skycosmetics.menu.broken: This section couldn't load. See the log.
skycosmetics.menu.brokenRow: This setting couldn't load. See the log.
skycosmetics.menu.tooSmall: Make the window bigger or lower the GUI scale.
skycosmetics.menu.search.tooltip: Finds settings in every section. Ctrl+F jumps here, or just start typing.
skycosmetics.menu.search.many: %s settings · Enter goes to the first
skycosmetics.menu.search.none.help: Nothing matches. Try fewer or shorter words.
skycosmetics.menu.section.studio.tooltip: Changes how your items and pets look: skins, dyes, names and glint.
skycosmetics.option.openStudio.back.tool: Returns to the item you were editing.
skycosmetics.option.openStudio.tooltip: Opens the studio for your held item, or any item in My Items.
skycosmetics.option.openStudio.noWorld: Join a world to use the studio
skycosmetics.option.openKey.tooltip: Opens the studio for the hovered item in any menu, or your held item.
skycosmetics.option.openKey.listening.to: Press a key or mouse button. Esc cancels, Backspace unbinds.
skycosmetics.option.inventoryButton.tool: Shows a brush on your player in the inventory that opens the studio.
skycosmetics.option.learnSkins.tooltip: Remembers skins the item repo doesn't have yet, like new shop previews.
skycosmetics.option.learnTiming.tooltip: Copies how fast animated skins really play in game, so blinks and flashes look right.
skycosmetics.option.storedItems.tooltip: Lists items from menus you open, like your Wardrobe, Ender Chest and Backpacks. Off: only what you wear and carry.
skycosmetics.option.storedItems.search: wardrobe ender chest backpack vault auto fill fetch
skycosmetics.option.allProfiles.tooltip: Lists items from all your SkyBlock profiles in My Items, not only the current one.
skycosmetics.option.worldReskin.tooltip: Shows your chosen skins on your summoned pet and placed power orbs.
skycosmetics.option.typeLooksOnOthers.to: Shows your looks for a whole item type (e.g. every Necron's Helmet) on other players too. Only you see them.
skycosmetics.option.namesInOtherMods.too: Lets other mods show your custom names, even in chat replies like Odin's !holding. Off: they see the original.
skycosmetics.studio.settings.tooltip: Open key, My Items and more
skycosmetics.studio.settings.keyTip: Set a key to open the studio from any menu
skycosmetics.saved.emptyHelp: Pick an item on the left and give it a skin, dye, name or glint. Every look you make is listed here.
skycosmetics.saved.part.name: Name
skycosmetics.saved.removeEvery: Remove the look from every item of this type
skycosmetics.other.aboutHelp: They show over SkyCosmetics' looks. Removing one here changes it in that mod's own settings.
skycosmetics.other.none: No other mod changes your items
skycosmetics.other.unseenHelp: Not in My Items yet: wear, hold or open it once to see its name
skycosmetics.other.kind.name: Name
skycosmetics.other.chip.name: Renamed by %s
skycosmetics.other.removeHelp: Changes %s's settings and saves them. Undo puts it back.
skycosmetics.other.removeAll: Remove every change on this item
skycosmetics.other.moveHelp: Saves it as your look here and removes it in %s
skycosmetics.other.kept: %s kept it: change it in its own settings
skycosmetics.chip.rightClick: Right-click to move it to SkyCosmetics
skycosmetics.chip.more: See every change in Other Mods
skycosmetics.option.accent.tooltip: Colors switches, sliders, selections and highlights, here and in the studio.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.tooltip: Colors the slot behind each item by its rarity.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.on.toolti: Draws a background in the color of each item's rarity, under the item.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.shape.sea: circle square rounded inset diamond frame corner glow
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.fill.tool: How the color spreads over the shape.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.outline.t: Adds a bright line around the shape.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.colors.to: Hypixel's rarity colors, softer or deeper ones, or your own.
Click a color to change it. Changing one switches to Custom.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.inventory: Your inventory and hotbar rows, in any menu.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.hotbar.to: The hotbar at the bottom of the screen.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.menus.too: Chests and Hypixel menus, like the auction house, bazaar and storage.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.gearMenus: What gets a background in the Wardrobe, Equipment and Loadouts menus.
wardrobe loadouts equipment armor sets skip hide heads
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.common.to: Common items get a background too. Off: Uncommon and up only.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.pets.tool: Pets by their tier, one higher with a Tier Boost.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.skyblockO: Only items with a SkyBlock ID. Menu buttons with a rarity line get none.
skycosmetics.rarityBackgrounds.recombMar: Marks recombobulated items with a small white corner, top right.
skycosmetics.headSize.tooltip: Changes the size of heads in inventories, menus and the hotbar.
skycosmetics.headSize.size.tooltip: Only the picture changes: slots and clicks stay the same.
skycosmetics.headSize.search: skull head scale larger heads icon
skycosmetics.headSize.inventory.tooltip: Your inventory, armor and hotbar rows in any menu, and the item on your cursor.
skycosmetics.headSize.menus.tooltip: Chests and Hypixel menus, like pets, the wardrobe and the auction house.
skycosmetics.headSize.hotbar.tooltip: The hotbar at the bottom of the screen.
skycosmetics.headSize.elsewhere.tooltip: Heads other screens and mods draw, like in tooltips and item lists.
skycosmetics.headSize.skyblockOnly.toolt: Only heads with a SkyBlock ID, like pets and accessories. Menu buttons keep their size.
skycosmetics.menu.section.hand.tooltip: How your first-person hand and held item look and swing. Only you see it.
skycosmetics.hand.search: viewmodel animations item position rotation size scale swing speed
skycosmetics.hand.option.handEnabled.too: Draws your hand and held item with your poses. Off: Minecraft's hand.
skycosmetics.hand.option.edit.tooltip: Opens the editor at the side of the screen, so you see your hand change as you drag.
skycosmetics.hand.option.edit.noWorld: Join a world to see your hand
skycosmetics.hand.rule.edit.tooltip: Opens this pose next to your hand
skycosmetics.hand.add.title: Add a Pose
skycosmetics.hand.add.tooltip: A pose for one kind of item, or for one SkyBlock item you carry. The most specific pose wins.
A new click doesn't restart a swing that is still playing.
skycosmetics.hand.option.handIgnoreEffec: Swings keep their speed under Haste and Mining Fatigue.
skycosmetics.hand.option.handEquipAnimat: When your held item dips and comes back up. Switching Slots skips the dip when an item updates or you use an ability.
skycosmetics.hand.option.handSway.toolti: How far your hand lags behind when you look around.
skycosmetics.hand.option.handEmptyAndMap: Uses the Everything pose for your bare hand and for maps too.
skycosmetics.hand.preset.previous.toolti: Your setup from before the last preset, import or code.
skycosmetics.hand.preset.name: Name
skycosmetics.hand.preset.save.tooltip: Saves every pose and option on this page under a name.
skycosmetics.hand.option.handVanilla.too: Removes every pose and option. Your setup is kept as a preset first.
skycosmetics.hand.import.found: Copies %s's item animation settings. Its file isn't changed.
skycosmetics.hand.import.on: %s's item animations are on and add to yours: turn them off there after importing.
skycosmetics.hand.share.tooltip: Copy puts your whole setup on the clipboard as one line of text. Paste uses one copied from anyone.
skycosmetics.hand.editor.hint: Right-click a slider to reset it.
skycosmetics.hand.editor.off: Hand Poses is off: only this editor shows the pose.
skycosmetics.hand.pivot.item.tooltip: Rotation turns the item around where you hold it.
skycosmetics.hand.pivot.hand.tooltip: Rotation turns your hand where it rests, and the swing turns with it.
skycosmetics.hand.pivot.view.tooltip: Rotation swings your whole hand around your eye.
skycosmetics.hand.swing.moving.tooltip: Minecraft's swing: the item travels forward and back.
skycosmetics.hand.swing.inPlace.tooltip: The item tilts where it is and doesn't travel.
skycosmetics.hand.swing.none.tooltip: No swing on screen. Your real swing still happens; only its drawing is skipped.
skycosmetics.hand.editor.test.tooltip: Plays a swing on screen only. Nothing is sent.
skycosmetics.hand.editor.repeat.tooltip: Keeps swinging, so you can watch the swing while you drag.
skycosmetics.hand.editor.reset.tooltip: Puts every number of this pose back to Minecraft's.
